'''Kolaador Base''', also known as the '''Pilot Training Center (PTC)''', was a facility on [[Kolaador]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to train [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
[[File:KolaadorBar.jpg|thumb|left|Inside Kolaador base]]
It was at this base that [[Rookie One]] completed his training under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ru Murleen]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. However their rest was cut short; when the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], the two pilots were alerted from the [[Anchorhead Base]] and left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

[[3 ABY/Legends|Three years later]], Rookie One would visit again the same bar.<ref name="LucasArts Update">{{InsiderCite|27|LucasArts Update|Excerpts from the Journal of a Rebel Pilot}}</ref>
